title: Knowledge sources
description: A venture's source map (<venture>/knowledge/sources.json, EE-037): the sources its records live in and which record types live where. Optional: a record type it does not name, and every record of a venture without one, lives in the venture's own folder (the implicit `venture` source). The venture decides its own layout; Mentura does not. Each source names a connector from the registry (an integration with a `connector` in knowledge/tooling/integrations.json). Credentials are named by environment variable, never stored.

id.description: The source's id; `venture` is reserved for the venture's own folder

connector.description: An integration id with a connector: filesystem, github

writes.description: How writes reach it; the connector's default when left out

root.description: filesystem: the folder, relative to the venture folder or absolute. github: the folder inside the repository

token.description: github: the environment variable holding a token (default GITHUB_TOKEN)

api.description: github: the API base, for GitHub Enterprise

search.description: github: code search (default) or a scan of the files

records.description: Record type id (from schema/data-model.json) -> source id. Unnamed record types stay in the venture folder.
